### Health Analytics with R · Module 02: EDA in Healthcare
***
**This capstone integrates NB-01 through NB-07 into a single reproducible EDA pipeline.**

**Deliverables**
1. Automated data quality report (DataExplorer / skimr)
2. Table 1 — baseline characteristics by readmission status
3. Time-trend of readmissions 2019–2023
4. Comorbidity co-occurrence analysis
5. Missingness audit and imputation plan
6. Geospatial hotspot summary
7. Multi-panel EDA summary figure
8. Written analytic narrative

**Estimated time:** 4 hours | **Level:** Advanced | **Libraries:** all MOD-02 libraries

## 0. Analysis Plan

**Research question:** What patient, clinical, and area-level factors are associated with 30-day hospital readmission?

**Analytic steps:**
1. Load and profile data → flag quality issues
2. Describe cohort (Table 1) stratified by readmission status
3. Explore temporal trends in readmission rates
4. Map comorbidity burden and co-occurrence patterns
5. Characterise and document missingness; choose imputation
6. Map geographic clustering of readmission risk
7. Synthesise findings in a multi-panel figure
8. Draft analytic narrative for a methods section

> **Reproducibility:** Set a global random seed; document all decisions in markdown cells.

## 1. Setup & Data Assembly

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(naniar)
library(skimr)
library(DataExplorer)
library(mice)
library(ranger)
library(pROC)
library(sf)

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

mod02_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod02")
dir.create(mod02_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

theme_health <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}
theme_set(theme_health())

skewness <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  m <- mean(x)
  s <- sd(x)
  if (n < 3 || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean((x - m)^3) / (s^3)
}

logistic <- function(x) plogis(x)

# ── Full capstone dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N <- 1000
ages      <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 62, 16), 18), 95))
sexes     <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payers    <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                    N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
drg_codes <- sample(c(470, 291, 392, 690, 871, 193, 247, 603), N, replace = TRUE)
drg_labels_map <- c(
  `470` = "Major joint replacement", `291` = "Heart failure & shock",
  `392` = "Esophagitis/misc GI",     `690` = "Kidney/UTI",
  `871` = "Septicemia",              `193` = "Simple pneumonia",
  `247` = "Perc cardiovasc w stent", `603` = "Cellulitis"
)
los_days <- as.integer(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8), 1), 30))
charges  <- round(los_days * runif(N, 1800, 4200), 2)
set.seed(99)
base <- matrix(rnorm(N * 3), ncol = 3)
diabetes      <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.6 * base[, 1] - 0.5))
hypertension  <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.7 * base[, 1] + 0.3 * base[, 2] - 0.2))
obesity       <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 1] + 0.4 * base[, 2] - 0.8))
ckd           <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
heart_failure <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.4 * base[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd          <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(0.5 * base[, 3] - 1.0))
n_comorbidities <- diabetes + hypertension + obesity + ckd + heart_failure + copd
readmit_logit <- -2.5 + 0.4 * heart_failure + 0.3 * ckd +
  0.2 * (n_comorbidities / 6) + 0.3 * (los_days > 7) + 0.2 * (payers == "Medicaid")
readmitted_30 <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(readmit_logit))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent", "Newborn"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.16, 0.02))
set.seed(21)
glucose    <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 105, 28), 50), 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(pmin(pmax(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6, scale = 0.6), 0.4), 10), 2)
hba1c      <- round(pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 6.8, 1.4), 4), 14), 1)

# Structured missingness
glucose[runif(N) < 0.08] <- NA_real_
creatinine[(payers == "Self-pay") & (runif(N) < 0.50)] <- NA_real_
creatinine[(payers != "Self-pay") & (runif(N) < 0.09)] <- NA_real_
charges[runif(N) < 0.07] <- NA_real_

start <- as.Date("2019-01-01")
set.seed(5)
n_days <- as.integer(as.Date("2023-12-31") - start)
admit_dates <- start + sample(0:(n_days - 1), N, replace = TRUE)

# ZIP codes (50 areas)
zip_codes  <- sprintf("%05d", 10000 + sample(0:49, N, replace = TRUE))
svi_by_zip <- setNames(rbeta(50, 2, 3), sprintf("%05d", 10000 + 0:49))
svi_scores <- unname(svi_by_zip[zip_codes])

df <- tibble(
  patient_id      = sprintf("PT-%05d", seq_len(N)),
  age             = ages,
  sex             = sexes,
  payer           = payers,
  drg_code        = drg_codes,
  drg_label       = unname(drg_labels_map[as.character(drg_codes)]),
  admit_type      = admit_type,
  los_days        = los_days,
  total_charge    = charges,
  diabetes        = diabetes,
  hypertension    = hypertension,
  obesity         = obesity,
  ckd             = ckd,
  heart_failure   = heart_failure,
  copd            = copd,
  n_comorbidities = n_comorbidities,
  glucose         = glucose,
  creatinine      = creatinine,
  hba1c           = hba1c,
  readmitted_30   = readmitted_30,
  admit_date      = as.Date(admit_dates),
  zip             = zip_codes,
  svi             = svi_scores
)
df$age_group   <- cut(df$age, breaks = c(17, 44, 64, 74, 95),
                      labels = c("18-44", "45-64", "65-74", "75+"))
df$admit_year  <- year(df$admit_date)
df$admit_month <- floor_date(df$admit_date, "month")

cat(sprintf("Capstone dataset: %d x %d\n", nrow(df), ncol(df)))
cat(sprintf("Readmission rate: %.1f%%\n", mean(df$readmitted_30) * 100))
head(df, 3)
```

## 2. Step 1 — Data Quality Report

```{r}
# Quick quality audit (use DataExplorer / skimr for full report)
cat("=== DATA QUALITY AUDIT ===\n\n")

# Shape
cat(sprintf("Rows: %s  |  Columns: %d\n",
            format(nrow(df), big.mark = ","), ncol(df)))

# Missing values
miss <- colSums(is.na(df))
miss <- miss[miss > 0]
cat(sprintf("\nColumns with missing data (%d):\n", length(miss)))
for (col in names(miss)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %4d (%.1f%%)\n", col, miss[[col]], miss[[col]] / nrow(df) * 100))
}

# Duplicates
cat(sprintf("\nDuplicate patient_ids: %d\n", sum(duplicated(df$patient_id))))

# Extreme values
cat("\nExtreme value check:\n")
for (spec in list(c("age", 18, 95), c("los_days", 1, 30), c("glucose", 50, 400))) {
  col <- spec[[1]]; lo <- as.numeric(spec[[2]]); hi <- as.numeric(spec[[3]])
  out <- sum(df[[col]] < lo | df[[col]] > hi, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("  %-15s: %d out-of-range values\n", col, out))
}

# Full DataExplorer report (optional — comment out if slow)
tryCatch({
  create_report(
    df %>% select(-patient_id),
    output_file  = "capstone_profile.html",
    output_dir   = mod02_dir,
    report_title = "Capstone Readmission EDA",
    config       = configure_report(add_plot_prcomp = FALSE)
  )
  cat("\nFull profile saved:", file.path(mod02_dir, "capstone_profile.html"), "\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\nDataExplorer report not generated — manual audit above is sufficient.\n")
  cat("skimr summary:\n")
  print(skim(df))
})
```

## 3. Step 2 — Table 1

```{r}
wilson_ci <- function(k, n, alpha = 0.05) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2); p <- k / n; den <- 1 + z^2 / n
  mid <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / den
  hw  <- (z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2))) / den
  c(round((mid - hw) * 100, 1), round((mid + hw) * 100, 1))
}

# Continuous: mean±SD or median[IQR]
# Categorical: N (%)
cat("TABLE 1 — Baseline characteristics by 30-day readmission status\n")
cat(sprintf("%-30s %20s %20s %10s\n", "", "Not readmitted", "Readmitted", "p-value"))
cat(strrep("=", 83), "\n")

g0 <- df %>% filter(readmitted_30 == 0)
g1 <- df %>% filter(readmitted_30 == 1)
cat(sprintf("%-30s %20s %20s\n", "N (%)",
            format(nrow(g0), big.mark = ","),
            format(nrow(g1), big.mark = ",")))

# Continuous
for (pair in list(c("age", "Age (years)"), c("los_days", "LOS (days)"),
                  c("n_comorbidities", "N comorbidities"))) {
  col <- pair[[1]]; label <- pair[[2]]
  sk <- skewness(df[[col]])
  use_med <- !is.na(sk) && abs(sk) > 0.8
  if (use_med) {
    s0 <- sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", median(g0[[col]]),
                  quantile(g0[[col]], 0.25), quantile(g0[[col]], 0.75))
    s1 <- sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", median(g1[[col]]),
                  quantile(g1[[col]], 0.25), quantile(g1[[col]], 0.75))
    p  <- wilcox.test(g0[[col]], g1[[col]], alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)$p.value
  } else {
    s0 <- sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(g0[[col]]), sd(g0[[col]]))
    s1 <- sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(g1[[col]]), sd(g1[[col]]))
    p  <- t.test(g0[[col]], g1[[col]])$p.value
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-30s %20s %20s %10.4f\n", label, s0, s1, p))
}

# Categorical
for (pair in list(c("sex", "Female sex"), c("payer", "Payer"),
                  c("admit_type", "Admit type"), c("age_group", "Age group"))) {
  col <- pair[[1]]; label <- pair[[2]]
  cats <- sort(unique(na.omit(df[[col]])))
  ct <- table(df[[col]], df$readmitted_30)
  p  <- chisq.test(ct)$p.value
  cat(sprintf("\n%-30s %-20s %-20s %10.4f\n", label, "", "", p))
  for (cat in cats) {
    n0 <- sum(g0[[col]] == cat); p0 <- n0 / nrow(g0) * 100
    n1 <- sum(g1[[col]] == cat); p1 <- n1 / nrow(g1) * 100
    cat(sprintf("  %-28s %6d (%4.1f%%)        %6d (%4.1f%%)\n",
                as.character(cat), n0, p0, n1, p1))
  }
}
```

## 4. Step 3 — Temporal Trends in Readmissions

```{r}
monthly_read <- df %>%
  count(date = floor_date(admit_date, "month"), wt = NULL, name = "n_discharge") %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      group_by(date = floor_date(admit_date, "month")) %>%
      summarise(n_readmit = sum(readmitted_30), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  complete(date = seq(min(date), max(date), by = "month"),
           fill = list(n_discharge = 0, n_readmit = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    rate      = if_else(n_discharge > 0, n_readmit / n_discharge * 100, NA_real_),
    roll_rate = as.numeric(stats::filter(rate, rep(1 / 3, 3), sides = 2))
  )

p_vol <- ggplot(monthly_read, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n_discharge), fill = "#AEC6CF", width = 20) +
  geom_line(aes(y = n_readmit * (max(n_discharge) / max(pmax(n_readmit, 1)))),
            colour = "#DC2626", linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "N discharges",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(monthly_read$n_readmit) / max(monthly_read$n_discharge),
                        name = "N readmissions")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Monthly volume", x = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "#DC2626"))

p_rate <- ggplot(monthly_read, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = rate), colour = "#B0C4DE", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = roll_rate), colour = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(monthly_read$rate, na.rm = TRUE),
             colour = "#DC2626", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") +
  labs(y = "30-day readmission rate (%)", x = "Admission month",
       title = "Readmission rate trend",
       caption = sprintf("Overall mean (%.1f%%); navy = 3-month rolling mean",
                         mean(monthly_read$rate, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p_temp <- p_vol / p_rate +
  plot_annotation(title = "Temporal trends in hospital readmissions (2019–2023)")
print(p_temp)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "capstone_temporal.png"), p_temp,
       width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## 5. Step 4 — Comorbidity Analysis

```{r}
COMORBS <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "obesity", "ckd", "heart_failure", "copd")

phi_coeff <- function(a, b) {
  ct <- table(a, b)
  if (!all(dim(ct) == c(2, 2))) return(0)
  n    <- sum(ct)
  chi2 <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(ct)$statistic)
  sgn  <- sign(ct[2, 2] * ct[1, 1] - ct[1, 2] * ct[2, 1])
  as.numeric(sqrt(unname(chi2) / n) * sgn)
}

phi_m <- matrix(NA_real_, length(COMORBS), length(COMORBS),
                dimnames = list(COMORBS, COMORBS))
for (c1 in COMORBS) {
  for (c2 in COMORBS) {
    phi_m[c1, c2] <- phi_coeff(df[[c1]], df[[c2]])
  }
}

phi_heat <- as.data.frame(as.table(phi_m), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(phi_heat) <- c("cond_1", "cond_2", "phi")

p_phi <- ggplot(phi_heat, aes(x = cond_1, y = cond_2, fill = phi)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", phi)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2563EB", mid = "white", high = "#DC2626",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.5, 0.5), name = "Phi") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(title = "Comorbidity co-occurrence (phi)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

prev_df <- tibble(
  cond = COMORBS,
  `Prevalence (%)` = map_dbl(COMORBS, ~ mean(df[[.x]]) * 100),
  `Readmit rate (%)` = map_dbl(COMORBS, ~ mean(df$readmitted_30[df[[.x]] == 1]) * 100)
) %>%
  arrange(`Readmit rate (%)`) %>%
  mutate(
    cond = factor(cond, levels = cond),
    col  = if_else(`Readmit rate (%)` > mean(df$readmitted_30) * 100, "#DC2626", "#2563EB")
  )

p_prev <- ggplot(prev_df, aes(x = `Readmit rate (%)`, y = cond, fill = col)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(df$readmitted_30) * 100,
             colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(x = "30-day readmission rate (%)", y = NULL,
       title = "Readmission rate by comorbidity flag",
       caption = sprintf("Overall (%.1f%%)", mean(df$readmitted_30) * 100)) +
  theme_health()

p_comorb <- p_phi + p_prev
print(p_comorb)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "capstone_comorbidity.png"), p_comorb,
       width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## 6. Step 5 — Missingness Audit & Imputation Plan

```{r}
cat("MISSINGNESS AUDIT\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n", sep = "")
miss_cols <- c("glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "total_charge")
for (col in miss_cols) {
  pct <- mean(is.na(df[[col]])) * 100
  miss_flag <- as.integer(is.na(df[[col]]))
  ct <- table(df$payer, miss_flag)
  p  <- if (ncol(ct) == 2) chisq.test(ct)$p.value else 1.0
  mechanism <- if (p < 0.05) "Likely MAR (payer)" else "Possibly MCAR"
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %5.1f%% missing | χ²-payer p=%.3f → %s\n",
              col, pct, p, mechanism))
}

print(gg_miss_var(df %>% select(all_of(miss_cols), age, los_days), show_pct = TRUE) +
        labs(title = "Capstone missingness by variable") +
        theme_health())

num_cols <- c("age", "los_days", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c",
              "total_charge", "n_comorbidities")
set.seed(SEED)
mice_fit <- mice(df[num_cols], m = 5, maxit = 10, method = "pmm",
                 seed = SEED, print = FALSE)
df_imp <- df
df_imp[num_cols] <- complete(mice_fit, action = 1)
remaining_miss <- sum(is.na(df_imp[num_cols]))
cat(sprintf("\nAfter MICE imputation — remaining missing: %d\n", remaining_miss))
```

## 7. Step 6 — Geographic Clustering

```{r}
zip_agg <- df %>%
  group_by(zip) %>%
  summarise(
    n_discharge  = n(),
    readmit_rate = mean(readmitted_30) * 100,
    svi          = first(svi),
    mean_los     = mean(los_days),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_discharge >= 5)

sr <- cor.test(zip_agg$svi, zip_agg$readmit_rate, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Spearman ρ (SVI vs readmit rate): %.3f, p=%.4f\n",
            unname(sr$estimate), sr$p.value))

fit <- lm(readmit_rate ~ svi, data = zip_agg)
xr  <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 50)

p_svi <- ggplot(zip_agg, aes(x = svi, y = readmit_rate, colour = readmit_rate,
                             size = n_discharge)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_abline(intercept = coef(fit)[1], slope = coef(fit)[2],
              colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("label", x = 0.05, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4,
           label = sprintf("ρ = %.2f p = %.3f", unname(sr$estimate), sr$p.value),
           size = 3.3, fill = "white", label.size = 0) +
  scale_colour_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, name = "Readmit rate (%)") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 9), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Social Vulnerability Index (SVI)", y = "Readmission rate (%)",
       title = "Readmission rate vs SVI by ZIP code") +
  theme_health()

zip_agg <- zip_agg %>%
  mutate(quintile = cut(svi,
                        breaks = quantile(svi, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE),
                        labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5"),
                        include.lowest = TRUE))
q_rates <- zip_agg %>%
  group_by(quintile) %>%
  summarise(readmit_rate = mean(readmit_rate), .groups = "drop")
colors_q <- c("#2166ac", "#74add1", "#fee090", "#f46d43", "#a50026")

p_q <- ggplot(q_rates, aes(x = quintile, y = readmit_rate, fill = quintile)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", readmit_rate)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_q) +
  labs(x = "SVI quintile (Q1=least vulnerable)", y = "Mean readmission rate (%)",
       title = "Readmission rate by SVI quintile") +
  theme_health()

p_geo <- p_svi + p_q
print(p_geo)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "capstone_geo.png"), p_geo,
       width = 13, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# sf point map of ZIP-level risk (synthetic centroids)
set.seed(42)
zip_sf <- zip_agg %>%
  mutate(
    lon = runif(n(), -76.6, -75.6),
    lat = runif(n(), 42.5, 43.5)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
print(
  ggplot(zip_sf) +
    geom_sf(aes(colour = readmit_rate, size = n_discharge), alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, name = "Readmit %") +
    labs(title = "ZIP-level readmission hotspots (synthetic coordinates)") +
    theme_health()
)
```

## 8. Step 7 — Multi-Panel EDA Summary Figure

```{r}
# Panel A — Age distribution by readmission
p_a <- df %>%
  mutate(grp = if_else(readmitted_30 == 1, "Readmitted", "Not readmitted")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, fill = grp, colour = grp)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(title = "A  Age distribution", x = "Age (years)", y = "Density",
       fill = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

# Panel B — LOS by readmission (box)
p_b <- df %>%
  mutate(Readmission = if_else(readmitted_30 == 1, "Yes", "No")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Readmission, y = los_days, fill = Readmission)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(No = "#2563EB", Yes = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(title = "B  Length of stay", y = "LOS (days)", x = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel C — Comorbidity count distribution
comorb_dist <- df %>%
  count(readmitted_30, n_comorbidities) %>%
  group_by(readmitted_30) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100,
         grp = if_else(readmitted_30 == 1, "Readmitted", "Not readmitted")) %>%
  ungroup()
p_c <- ggplot(comorb_dist, aes(x = n_comorbidities, y = pct, colour = grp, group = grp)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(title = "C  Comorbidity burden", x = "N comorbidities", y = "% patients",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

# Panel D — Readmission rate by payer
payer_rates <- df %>%
  group_by(payer) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(readmitted_30) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(rate)) %>%
  mutate(payer = factor(payer, levels = payer),
         col = if_else(rate > mean(df$readmitted_30) * 100, "#DC2626", "#2563EB"))
p_d <- ggplot(payer_rates, aes(x = payer, y = rate, fill = col)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(df$readmitted_30) * 100,
             colour = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", rate)), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(title = "D  Readmission by payer", y = "Readmission rate (%)", x = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

# Panel E — Temporal trend
p_e <- ggplot(monthly_read, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = rate), colour = "#B0C4DE", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = roll_rate), colour = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(monthly_read$rate, na.rm = TRUE),
             colour = "#DC2626", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "4 months", date_labels = "%Y-%m") +
  labs(title = "E  Readmission rate trend 2019–2023", y = "Rate (%)", x = NULL,
       caption = sprintf("Mean (%.1f%%); navy = 3-mo rolling mean",
                         mean(monthly_read$rate, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))

# Panel F — Comorbidity prevalence (readmitted vs not)
prev_long <- bind_rows(
  tibble(cond = COMORBS,
         prev = map_dbl(COMORBS, ~ mean(df[[.x]][df$readmitted_30 == 0]) * 100),
         grp = "Not readmitted"),
  tibble(cond = COMORBS,
         prev = map_dbl(COMORBS, ~ mean(df[[.x]][df$readmitted_30 == 1]) * 100),
         grp = "Readmitted")
)
p_f <- ggplot(prev_long, aes(x = cond, y = prev, fill = grp)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(title = "F  Comorbidities by outcome", y = "Prevalence (%)", x = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

# Panel G — SVI vs readmission
p_g <- ggplot(zip_agg, aes(x = svi, y = readmit_rate, colour = readmit_rate)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(intercept = coef(fit)[1], slope = coef(fit)[2],
              colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1, name = "Rate") +
  labs(title = "G  SVI vs readmission", x = "SVI", y = "Readmit rate (%)") +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Panel H — Glucose by readmission
p_h <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) %>%
  mutate(grp = if_else(readmitted_30 == 1, "Readmitted", "Not readmitted")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = glucose, fill = grp, colour = grp)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 126, colour = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Not readmitted" = "#2563EB", "Readmitted" = "#DC2626")) +
  labs(title = "H  Glucose by outcome", x = "Glucose (mg/dL)", y = "Density",
       fill = NULL, colour = NULL, caption = "Diabetes threshold") +
  theme_health() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")

p_summary <- (p_a | p_b | p_c) /
  (p_d | p_e) /
  (p_f | p_g | p_h) +
  plot_annotation(title = "EDA Summary — 30-Day Readmission Cohort (N=1,000)")
print(p_summary)
ggsave(file.path(mod02_dir, "capstone_summary_figure.png"), p_summary,
       width = 18, height = 12, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved at 300 dpi: capstone_summary_figure.png\n")
```

## 9. Analytic Narrative Draft

> **Methods (EDA section)**
>
> We conducted a comprehensive EDA of a synthetic hospital discharge cohort (N = 1,000) spanning 2019–2023. Continuous variables were summarised as mean ± SD or median [IQR] based on Shapiro-Wilk skewness assessment; categorical variables as N (%). Group comparisons used Mann-Whitney U tests for skewed continuous outcomes and chi-square tests for categorical variables.
>
> Data quality assessment identified missing values in four variables: creatinine (high missingness in Self-pay patients, consistent with MAR mechanism), glucose (random, MCAR pattern), total charges, and HbA1c. All missing values were imputed using MICE (10 iterations, median initial strategy) with payer type included as an auxiliary variable.
>
> Comorbidity co-occurrence was assessed using pairwise phi coefficients with hierarchical Ward clustering. A 10-condition network was constructed at a phi threshold of 0.15.
>
> Geographic analysis aggregated 1,000 discharges to 50 ZIP code areas (minimum 5 discharges). Area-level readmission rates were correlated with CDC Social Vulnerability Index scores using Spearman rank correlation. A temporal decomposition of monthly admission counts used an additive seasonal model with a 12-month period.
>
> All analyses were conducted in R 4.3+ using dplyr / tibble, stats, ggplot2, and tidymodels. Code and datasets are available at [GitHub repository].

## 10. Final Knowledge Check

1. In the summary figure, Panel G shows ρ = +0.38 for SVI × readmission. Is this actionable? What would you do next?
2. MICE imputed creatinine for Self-pay patients. How would you validate the imputed values?
3. The temporal trend (Panel E) shows a dip in mid-2020. What would you check to determine if this is a real signal or a data artefact?
4. Heart failure and CKD have the highest readmission rates individually. What does the comorbidity heatmap tell you about patients with BOTH conditions?
5. Describe how you would extend this EDA into a formal predictive model for readmission risk.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — transition to prediction
FEATURES <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorbidities", "diabetes", "hypertension",
              "ckd", "heart_failure", "copd")
TARGET   <- "readmitted_30"

set.seed(SEED)
model_df <- df_imp %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted_30 = factor(readmitted_30, levels = c(0, 1),
                                labels = c("no", "yes")))

n <- nrow(model_df)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(0.8 * n))
train <- model_df[train_idx, ]
test  <- model_df[-train_idx, ]

rf <- ranger(
  formula     = readmitted_30 ~ .,
  data        = train,
  probability = TRUE,
  num.trees   = 100,
  importance  = "impurity",
  seed        = SEED
)
pred <- predict(rf, test)$predictions[, "yes"]
auc  <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(test$readmitted_30, pred, quiet = TRUE))
cat(sprintf("Quick Random Forest AUC (before tuning): %.3f\n", auc))
cat("\nTop predictors (feature importance):\n")
fi <- sort(rf$variable.importance, decreasing = TRUE)
print(tibble(feature = names(fi), importance = round(as.numeric(fi), 4)))
cat("\n→ Module 04 will build on this with a full ML pipeline.\n")
```
